title: A Kitchen for the Harbor
author: Dominic Vasquez
blurb: August Voss, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
